name: partial_day_window
commitment: Hit at least 8000 steps in this 36-hour window.

expected.rationale: Window starts mid-day on Apr 13. Steps from noon Apr 13 through end-of-day = 6800 - 4100 = 2700. Plus all of Apr 14 = 9200. Total = 11,900 steps, exceeds 8000. The trap: a model that sums daily totals (6800 + 9200 = 16,000) overcounts by including pre-window steps. A model that sums only Apr 14 (9200) gets the right answer for the wrong reason. Correct path is to use intraday data and subtract the 4100 pre-window count.
